limitations: Single-step mode agreement does not establish independent dynamic or measured validation.
At 0.5 ms cases 20 and 61 do not finish requested revolutions in 30 s; their incomplete-run stride is not a converged steady gait.
At 0.025 ms case 61 also does not finish within 30 s; decreasing timestep has not established convergence.
Original cohort case 16 fails the support gate; its every-step diagnostic demonstrates sampling alias and does not replace the failure.
Runner support and reported peak loop/penetration depend on decimated logging; all-step audit coverage remains to be repaired.
Normal stabilization, contact activation, soft-ground unit/damping errors and zero-speed pin friction remain open.
Original native 192 runs and historical failures are retained; no audit gate or physical evidence level is relaxed.
